Introducing Muse Code and Muse Spark 1.2

Muse Code is a terminal coding agent from Meta Superintelligence Labs, in beta.

Models and pricing

Muse Code runs on muse-spark-1.1, muse-spark-1.3 and muse-spark-1.2.

List price: $1.25 per million input tokens, $4.25 per million output tokens, and $0.15 per million cached input tokens.
